name: auth-failure
description: A revoked or wrong API key. The Integration API answers 401 on the very first call (the sites lookup), and the run must end with a printed diagnostic and zero assets - one request, no client or device fetches attempted against a credential the controller already refused. 401 is outside get_json's retry set, so exactly one request is made.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR rather than reporting a successful run with zero assets: a refused credential and an empty tenant are otherwise the same result, and only the exit status separates them.

log_contains: unifi: failed to get the sites list: status 401
error_contains: unifi: failed to get the sites list
